segments.text: Bugun, masalan, qurulish kampanyasi blan kelishti.
Video ni yarad shchun bolad yamos,
na nobanana wa xix fil suni intelektlardan faydalanab,
tor bay saatichide, bitti video ni tayyarkilab topshir shiz bolad.
Kunigi, ikite shunak video ni behem alol topshir shizmunkun.
Khullas, kanchako pishlasi, shunchoko prapul tophasiz.
Asasisi, kompyutor, internet, wa yakhshi fantazi, wa blamiz bolishkiri.
This is my Adam Education AI xunarmat kursibar.
Bitti kursi foto, video, site, telegram bot ilova xammasin orgetxadi.
Fakat nazari emas ozlari artirgan amali tajribanayam orgetxadi.
Shukungi quli yeddi minna ashik adamlegi zamanavi kas plana orgetxayan.
Ishqalib AI mutakais bubdur bur kundan echbil tapshi munkulligini.
Agar zidan suni intilikta organibdurub daramat tapmokchi boladiyan bosiz,
pastiga xawal arqali bemolol Beepol konsultatsiagi yazilin.
